The finding maps to the configured vocabulary key for patellar/acetabular calcific stippling (synonyms: stippled epiphyseal, punctate calcifications). The patient became completely wheelchair dependence when at 21 years old. Due to progressive mental retardation, magnetic resonance (MR) imaging was done and the brain T2-weighted images (see Fig. 1) showed cerebral white matter hyperintensity in the both centrum semiovale posteriorly with sparing of subcortical fibers, bilateral areas of signal increase surrounding posterior parts of lateral ventricles, hyperintensive posterior limbs of the internal capsules, and the small hyperintense signal in the genu and splenium of the corpus callosum.
